title: phanera pottingeri
intro: Phanera pottingeri, commonly known as the Indian cordia, is a type of plant species that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The plant has been traditionally used to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin infections due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and alkaloids.
